description:
It’s not just a new bike. It's a new dimension of urban mobility, engineered with the same family-first approach that defines every Urban Arrow. It’s as compact as a regular bike, but with the capacity of a cargo bike. Effortlessly maneuver through the city, park anywhere, and enjoy ultimate flexibility. The Urban Arrow Breeze gives you truly a thousand ways to ride, effortlessly adapting to your everyday needs. Its unparalleled versatility is built into every aspect of the bike, ensuring it's the perfect companion as your life evolves.

The Urban Arrow Breeze truly rides like a standard bicycle offering a natural feel. It’s a seamless transition for anyone used to a traditional bike, making it incredibly versatile for both family transport and solo errands. Navigate bustling city streets, tight corners, and crowded bike paths with ease. Breeze's design makes it agile and easy to handle, simplifying parking and storage in tight city spaces. This new bike to our family makes every ride easy and enjoyable, no matter your experience level. Its low step-through frame and smaller wheels create a bike that's incredibly easy to use, perfect for smaller riders or anyone less experienced on two wheels. With the suspension front fork, you'll experience a butter-smooth ride that glides effortlessly over bumps and uneven city streets, making every journey a real pleasure.

Don't let its sleek design fool you. The Urban Arrow Breeze packs impressive and adaptable cargo power. Its extended rear rack system is engineered to securely carry everything from two little passengers and school bags to groceries or sports gear, with a total carrying capacity of up to 200 kg. What's more, as your children grow, this bike really shines. It's perfectly suited for older kids up to 8 years old (but extending comfortably to the higher end of that range and beyond), allowing them to hop on and off with ease, making every family outing a genuine breeze. The Urban Arrow Breeze is designed to adapt to your ever-changing needs. With our wide range of accessories, you can truly customize your ride for any adventure. Experience ultimate convenience with the integrated MIK HD system on both the front and rear. It enables instant, tool-free changes of accessories, effortlessly transforming the Urban Arrow Breeze for whatever life throws your way. And for those longer journeys or heavier loads, you can even upgrade your battery for extended range and power.

At Urban Arrow your family's safety is our first priority. Always has been and always will be. That's why the Urban Arrow Breeze features a stable kickstand for secure loading. For little legs and curious fingers, spoke and belt protection offers peace of mind, safeguarding against accidental contact. Beyond safety, we’ve added smart touches for your daily ride. Keep your chain lock securely stored and enjoy quick, easy stops with the integrated front lock and a fixed Purion 200 display makes you ride without any worries. This thoughtful and smart design with smaller wheels gives a remarkably stable and secure riding experience. The ergonomic setup with a comfortable upright riding posture, ensures a relaxed and confident journey.

We already knew the Urban Arrow Breeze was a next-level champion. Now the experts just confirmed it. Our newest family member has won a remarkable two awards! We’re seriously proud of this recognition. Ready to explore what makes it an award-winning ride?

Making every ride easy and enjoyable.

Please get in touch with your local dealer for the latest availability of the Urban Arrow Breeze.

The Breeze is available in two colours: black and green.

No, Urban Arrow Connected is not compatible with the Urban Arrow Breeze. Check with your dealer for the tracking devices available.

Yes, when you purchase an Urban Arrow Breeze, both the front and rear racks are included.

The Breeze is designed to carry various weights in different areas to ensure optimal performance and safety. The maximum weight for the driver is set at 120 kilograms. In the rear carrier, you can transport up to 80 kilograms. The frontcarrier of the bike is equipped to manage up to 15 kilograms. Overall, the total maximum weight the bike can handle is 200 kilograms. Always ensure that the total weight does not exceed 200 kilograms to maintain safety and functionality while riding.

The minimum recommended age for transporting kids on the Breeze is 9 months, when placed in a compatible child seat, which is compatible with the MIK HD carrier. Always ensure that the child seat is securely fastened and appropriately adjusted to fit the child, providing a safe and enjoyable experience for your little one during your bike journeys.

For the Urban Arrow Breeze we offer several accessoires. For extra safety and comfort for your little ones, you can equip your bike with a protection bar and footrest, which provide added security for passengers. Both back as seat cushions are available to ensure a more comfortable ride. For carrying additional cargo, there are several options. The front carrier - which is standard included on the bike - allows you to transport extra items on the front of the bike, while the front carrier pannier offers added storage space. The cargo pannier provides ample room for carrying larger loads, and the single pannier is perfect for smaller, everyday items. These accessories make your bike more versatile and practical for different riding experiences.

The Breeze frame is designed to be a one size fits all. The recommended rider height is 5'1" to 6'4".

The Breeze rear rack is compatible with any MIK-HD child seat on the market. Common models are the following: United States Thule Yepp 2 MIK-HDBurley Dash RM MIK-HD Canada Bobike Go® Maxi MIK-HDThule Yepp 2 MIK-HDUrban Iki Ta-Ke MIK-HDBurley Dash RM MIK-HD

The Urban Arrow Breeze weighs 77.2 lbs (35 kg).

The Urban Arrow Breeze is only available in green.

The Breeze rear rack carries up to two children. You can install up to two MIK-HD child seats for younger kids, use the protection bar for older kids, or combine a single child seat with a seat cushion.

Want to know more? Get in touch with your local Urban Arrow to learn about the latest availability of Breeze.
